whatItIs: Predictive estimate of sustainable workload (MPG) after an OFFSEASON team change. NOT a causal or physiological latent minute ceiling.

eligiblePopulation.rule: NBA player-team transitions with >=20 games on Team A before the cutoff and >=10 games on Team B after
eligiblePopulation.scopeNotValidated: IN-SEASON trades — incremental value over Team A season MPG NOT established

predictionCutoff: Immediately before the player's first Team B game. All inputs from Team A / pre-transition history only.

targets.primary_tFirst10: mean MPG over the first 10 Team B games
targets.t6to15: mean MPG over Team B games 6-15 (requires >=15) — reduces immediate-transition noise
targets.tRest: mean MPG over all Team B games in that stint

featuresConsideredAndExcluded.reason: The destination-context variables TESTED HERE added little incremental predictive value (54.6% vs 54.7% matched-pair concordance). This is a statement about these features, not about whether destination fit matters.

preprocessing: z-score each feature using TRAINING mean/sd; ridge penalty 1e-5 * n on slopes only, never the intercept; missing attributes default age 26, height 78in, weight 210lb, draftPick 61, undrafted 1 (0.1% of rows).

validation.grouped: 5-fold grouped by PLAYER — no player appears in both train and test
validation.note: Both are reported. Chronological validation is NOT player-disjoint (92 of 138 holdout players appear in earlier seasons); grouped CV is the player-disjoint result. Neither alone is sufficient.

uncertainty: Empirical residual quantiles from TRAINING data only. 50% interval = pred + [q25, q75]; 80% = pred + [q10, q90].

evidenceGrade.basis: count of TRAINING transitions with Team A season MPG within +/-3 of the candidate
evidenceGrade.status: CONVENIENCE LABEL, NOT A STATISTICAL GUARANTEE. The cutoffs were chosen for readability and have not been separately validated. The raw support count is always shown alongside.
evidenceGrade.inSeasonOverride: Incremental TULIP evidence: Unproven — season-MPG baseline recommended

knownLimitations: Individual MAE ~5.0-5.4 MPG. This is a ranking and comparison tool, not a precise minute forecast.
In-season trades: no demonstrated incremental value over Team A season MPG.

On the 2024-25 offseason holdout the advantage is inconsistent by quintile — worse than baseline in the two lowest-workload quintiles (6.26 vs 5.81, 6.69 vs 6.62), better in the upper three. n=18 per quintile.
Predictive, NOT causal. Teams trade, waive and sign players for reasons the box score cannot observe; that selection is baked into the training data.
No position field: height/weight act as a positional proxy.
Rest-of-season target is rest-of-STINT with that team, not literally the season end.

validationModel.note: used ONLY for the out-of-sample historical leaderboard
